content.title: Planning With Uncertainty: Deep Exploration in Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
content.TL;DR: Demonstrating deep exploration with MuZero by planning optimistically with epistemic uncertainty
content.abstract: Deep model-based reinforcement learning has shown super-human performance in many challenging domains. Low sample efficiency and limited exploration remain however as leading obstacles in the field. In this paper, we demonstrate deep exploration in model-based RL by incorporating epistemic uncertainty into planning trees, circumventing the standard approach of propagating uncertainty through value learning. We evaluate this approach with the state of the art model-based RL algorithm MuZero, and extend its training process to stabilize learning from explicitly-exploratory decisions. Our results demonstrate that planning with uncertainty is able to achieve effective deep exploration with standard uncertainty estimation mechanisms, and with it significant gains in sample efficiency.
